text:
zoe: Quick sync / tiny PR to tidy up remaining v1 -> v2 examples across the site. Found a few curl, python, and README snippets still using models.invoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1201 :mag:
liam: thanks! can we make v2 canonical and add a brief compatibility collapsible? customers still hitting the shim but pages should default to v2. :thumbsup:
tara: agree on canonical v2. small request: add a one-line embed alias note (embed-legacy-512 -> rwd-embed-512-v2) and point to /assets/alias_map_v2.json.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] example-lint failed on examples/usage.md: found `X-Old-Auth` header and `models.invoke` usage.
zoe: noted. will replace curl header with Authorization: Bearer and models.invoke -> client.responses.create. also add a 2-line streaming hint recommending SDK stream helpers.
liam: please include a tiny JS and Python polyfill snippet for teams who want to keep older callsites temporarily. e.g. `def invoke_v1_compat(...):` mapping to v2.
zoe: will add polyfills and a short mapping list (model_id -> model, stop_sequences -> stop, functions -> tools).
product: product wants the deprecation one-liner included in changelog and a comms blurb: "Docs examples consolidated to v2 canonical patterns; v1 shim supported until 2025-12-31."
tara: i'll draft the changelog entry and the small embed note.
liam: lgtm. once CI is green, merge. small gate: 2 approvals + examples CI green.
zoe: pushing fixes now. will update PR link when done. :rocket:
